Meta.title: Wildscope: AI Wildlife Identification & Nature Exploration App
Meta.description: Discover and identify wildlife with AI technology, explore nature with offline maps, and track animals like a pro. Your ultimate outdoor companion for wildlife adventures.

Hero.title: AI-Powered Wildlife Identification & Nature Exploration
Hero.subtitle: Identify plants and animals instantly, track wildlife with precision, and explore nature confidently - even offline. Your complete outdoor companion powered by advanced AI.

About.title: Your Complete Wildlife Identification & Nature Guide
About.paragraph1: Experience nature like never before with Wildscope's advanced AI technology. Whether you're identifying plants on a hike, tracking wildlife in remote areas, or learning about local ecosystems, our comprehensive features work seamlessly online and offline.
About.bullet1: Instant AI-powered identification of plants, animals, and fungi
About.bullet2: Detailed offline maps and species guides for any location
About.bullet3: Interactive learning through quizzes and adventure mode
About.bullet4: GPS navigation and wildlife tracking tools
About.paragraph2: From casual nature walks to serious wildlife tracking, Wildscope combines cutting-edge AI technology with comprehensive outdoor tools to enhance every nature experience.

Features.title: Complete Wildlife Identification & Nature Exploration Tools
Features.feature1_desc: Instantly identify thousands of species with our AI-powered recognition system. Get detailed information about animals, plants, and fungi, including behavior patterns, habitat preferences, and seasonal variations.
Features.feature2_desc: Never lose your way with our comprehensive offline mapping system. Download regional maps and wildlife data for reliable navigation and species identification, even in remote areas without cell service.
Features.feature3_desc: Learn about nature through engaging quizzes, challenges, and our unique text-based adventure mode. Test your knowledge, improve your outdoor skills, and discover new species in your area.
Features.feature4_desc: Access all essential features without internet connection. Our offline mode includes species data, detailed maps, wildlife guides, and navigation tools - perfect for remote adventures.
Features.feature5_desc: Get personalized guidance from our AI nature expert. Ask questions about local wildlife, receive species-specific tips, and learn about ecosystems through natural conversation.
Features.feature6_desc: Connect with nature enthusiasts worldwide. Share wildlife sightings, discover new locations, and contribute to our growing database of species observations.

CallToAction.title: Don't Miss Another Amazing Wildlife Moment!
CallToAction.subtitle: Join thousands of nature enthusiasts who are already discovering and identifying wildlife like never before. Download Wildscope now and transform your outdoor adventures!

PrivacyPage.data_collection_intro: Most data is stored locally on your device. Data is only stored in the cloud or external services when you use specific features.
PrivacyPage.location_data_info:
• Processing occurs locally on your device, no permanent storage
• Location data is only sent to external services when certain features are used:
  - Google Places & OpenStreetMap (OSM): Autocomplete & POI search
  - GBIF: Query animals & plants in your region
  - OpenWeather: Weather data based on your location
  - OpenElevation: Elevation information for terrain analysis
  - Google Gemini & OpenAI: If you use AI features (e.g., quiz, adventure mode)
PrivacyPage.firebase_info:
• We use Firebase for user authentication and data storage
• Data such as user accounts, posts, comments, and uploads are stored in Firebase
• Firebase implements its own security and access controls to protect your data
PrivacyPage.analytics_info:
• We use PostHog for anonymized usage statistics
• PostHog helps us understand and improve app usage
• Data collected includes: screens visited, app interactions, session duration
• No personal data is linked to your account
• You can disable tracking at any time in the settings
PrivacyPage.account_data_info:
• Registration required
• Storage of: username, email address, premium status
• Passwords are stored encrypted
PrivacyPage.uploads_info:
Data is only stored in the cloud when you:
• Share an image or video: Username, date & location of capture
• Create a post: Text is stored, but not your location
• Like or comment: Only the interaction itself is stored
PrivacyPage.external_content_info:
• External content is embedded
• These services use their own tracking technologies
PrivacyPage.youtube_api_info: Our application uses YouTube API Services to provide you with video content related to outdoor activities, nature, and survival skills. By using our Media Feed feature, you acknowledge and agree to be bound by the YouTube Terms of Service (https://www.youtube.com/t/terms) and Google's Privacy Policy (http://www.google.com/policies/privacy).
PrivacyPage.youtube_data_collection_info:
When you use our Media Feed feature, we access and collect the following information through YouTube API Services:

From YouTube API:
• Public video metadata including titles, descriptions, thumbnails, channel names, and publication dates
• Video URLs and identifiers
• Search results based on your location and selected content categories

From Your Device:
• Your location data (when location-based feeds are enabled) to provide geographically relevant video content
• App preferences and settings stored locally on your device
• Cached video data stored temporarily in your device's local storage
PrivacyPage.youtube_data_storage_info:
• Video metadata retrieved from YouTube API is cached locally on your device for up to 24 hours to improve app performance and reduce data usage
• Cached data includes video details, timestamps, selected categories, location scope, and location information
• No user authentication data or personal YouTube account information is stored
• All cached data is stored locally on your device using AsyncStorage and is not transmitted to external servers
PrivacyPage.youtube_data_usage_info:
We use the collected information to:
• Display relevant outdoor and nature-related video content in our Media Feed
• Provide location-based video recommendations when you enable location feeds
• Cache content locally to improve app performance and offline capability
• Filter and sort video results based on your preferences and location
PrivacyPage.youtube_data_sharing_info:
• We do not share any user data or YouTube API data with third parties for commercial purposes
• Video interactions within embedded YouTube players are subject to YouTube's own privacy practices and may be tracked by Google/YouTube
• Our app uses its own YouTube API credentials and does not access your personal YouTube account
• Location data used for video searches is processed locally and combined with public search terms
PrivacyPage.youtube_cookies_info:
• When viewing embedded YouTube videos, YouTube may place cookies or similar technologies on your device in accordance with Google's privacy practices
• Our app accesses local device storage (AsyncStorage) to cache video content and store user preferences
• We may collect device information necessary for app functionality, including location data for location-based features
PrivacyPage.youtube_data_retention_info:
• Locally cached video metadata is automatically deleted after 24 hours
• User preferences and settings remain stored locally until you uninstall the app or manually clear app data
• No YouTube API data is permanently stored on external servers
PrivacyPage.youtube_user_rights_info:
You can:
• Disable location-based video feeds in app settings
• Clear cached data by refreshing the Media Feed or clearing app storage
• Access YouTube videos directly through the YouTube app or website where Google's privacy controls apply
• Contact us to request information about data collected through our app
PrivacyPage.youtube_third_party_info:
By using YouTube API Services within our app, you are also subject to:
• Google Privacy Policy: http://www.google.com/policies/privacy
• YouTube Terms of Service: https://www.youtube.com/t/terms

FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Wildlife Tracking
FAQ.question1: How does Wildscope compare to other nature identification apps like iNaturalist?
FAQ.answer1: While iNaturalist focuses primarily on species identification and citizen science, Wildscope offers a complete outdoor experience with additional features specifically designed for nature enthusiasts. Our app includes offline wildlife identification, GPS navigation tools for wilderness exploration, interactive learning through nature quizzes, and an AI companion that understands your environment to provide personalized guidance—making it perfect for both casual nature lovers and serious wildlife trackers.
FAQ.question2: Can I identify plants and animals offline with Wildscope?
FAQ.answer2: Partially. The AI analysis requires an internet connection, but you'll see all tracked species from your area displayed and can use these to help with identification.
FAQ.question3: Which devices support the Wildscope nature exploration app?
FAQ.answer3: Wildscope's wildlife tracking and nature identification features are available for both iOS (iPhone/iPad) and Android devices through the App Store and Google Play Store, making it accessible for virtually all smartphone users.
FAQ.question4: Is Wildscope wildlife identification app free to use?
FAQ.answer4: Wildscope offers a free version with essential wildlife identification and nature exploration features. Our premium subscription unlocks advanced capabilities like unlimited species findings, more credits, more custom places to visit, and additional benefits. Check the app for current subscription options.
FAQ.question5: How accurate is Wildscope's plant and animal identification?
FAQ.answer5: Wildscope combines location data with advanced AI technology to identify wildlife and plants with high accuracy. While our recognition system continuously improves, identification accuracy varies by species, image quality, and viewing angle. We're constantly enhancing our algorithms through regular updates to provide increasingly accurate wildlife and plant identification in all environments.
FAQ.question6: Can I contribute to Wildscope's wildlife database?
FAQ.answer6: Absolutely! Wildscope thrives on community contributions. Your wildlife observations and plant identifications are securely added to our ecosystem database, improving the app's accuracy for everyone. This collaborative approach creates a comprehensive wildlife identification resource that benefits all nature enthusiasts.
FAQ.question7: Is Wildscope developed by a large tech company?
FAQ.answer7: No, Wildscope is an independent project developed by a dedicated nature enthusiast. The app is designed and maintained by a single passionate developer who prioritizes accuracy and user experience over monetization. This independent approach ensures that Wildscope remains true to its core mission: helping people connect with and understand nature without compromising user privacy or experience.
